Thunderton House Much of this building dates from the 16th century. It was known as the Great Lodging, a royal residence, and later the town house of several successive noble families. Bonnie Prince Charlie stayed here in 1746, just before the Battle of Culloden. The house is now a popular pub.

The 'Northern Scot' Offices The 'Northern Scot' is Elgin's weekly newspaper, published every Friday. Until a few years ago its premises, including printing presses, were in a warren-like collection of buildings in a close off the High Street, but the actual printing is no longer done in Elgin, and the editorial and advertising offices moved into smaller premises.
